purpose: Record the same-input visual-planning availability and result quality of locally installed model CLIs without treating a text plan as a generated 3D asset.

input.promptPolicy: Same structured visual-planning prompt for every available CLI; no scale reference was supplied.

notes: Correctly classified the object as an industrial floor fan and described major asymmetries and uncertainty.
Grouped repeated and connected parts instead of producing the 101 independently editable units required by the pilot contract.
Dimension estimates cannot be accepted as measured because the images contain no calibrated scale evidence.

providers.blocker: Claude CLI reported loggedIn=false and no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was present.
Gemini CLI returned IneligibleTierError and required migration to a supported client or a configured API key.

comparison.reason: Two providers were unavailable and the one completed provider produced a visual plan rather than AssemblyIR or a 3D deliverable.
